description.zh_cn: 在 CanonRock 示例谱面中，先播放教学段落，再参照草稿区完成主轨道物件，最后重播检查。基础和进阶教学可分别进入；每次进入都会还原示例谱面的主轨道物件。
description.en_us: In the CanonRock sample chart, preview each section, match its draft-lane reference in the player lanes, then replay it. Basics and advanced lessons have separate routes. Entering either route restores the sample's player-lane notes.
